title: Binding of the Lightdash marketing design-repo to the N0 common SaaS design-constraint policy

classification.marketModel: B2B SaaS (self-serve cloud plans, enterprise sales, open-source self-hosted tier)

evidence.claim: tiered subscription plans (Cloud Pro, monthly price)
B2B trust surface: SOC2 compliance page

generationRules: PageSpecs declare mode clone | generation; generation pages may not contain Lightdash identity, copy, claims, people, customers, URLs, embeds or clone-only / blocked assets (schema/semantic_validate.py GENERATION_MODE_*; patterns in schema/source-identity.json; availability pinned in code).

Pages are composed only from the 30 templates and 95 composable section contracts; template node lists, chrome axis and theme are enforced (TEMPLATE_NODE_MATCH, ROUTE_RESTRICTION, compatibility/graph.json rules).

Pricing / plan / comparison sections are CONVERSION-classed; compliance badges and numeric proof are never fabricated: generation mode only accepts operator-supplied badges (badge.compliance is blocked-for-generation).
Style references are catalog tokens only (TOKEN_* rules); motion uses the closed motion patterns with const-locked reduced-motion fallbacks.
Runtime UI (modal, drawers, iframe app states) is never retrievable page content (PINNED_RETRIEVAL); no section may hold most of a page (extraction/wrapper_gate.py over measured heights).
contentHashNote: registry.manifest.json designPolicy.contentHash = sha256 over the files listed in enforcedBy (sorted by path; each contributes its path, a NUL byte, its bytes and a NUL byte). verify_all.py recomputes it. The text of the common policy n0-saas-design-constraints-common itself is not shipped in this repo and was not available to this build; the hash covers this repo's enforcing files, not the common policy document.

approval.note: Classification (B2B SaaS) is an agent decision from the evidence above (agent attestation, not a human sign-off). A human architecture owner must ratify the binding.
